tool_schemas.name: get_access_token
tool_schemas.description: Returns a valid Spotify OAuth access token for the requested subject (the server token or a specific Spotify user token), refreshing it when expired or when force_refresh is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if subject_type is spotify_user without spotify_user_id, and NOT_FOUND if no stored token exists for the requested subject. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the token cannot be refreshed (for example, the refresh token is invalid or revoked) and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the server’s audit-log quota/rate limits block additional Spotify API calls needed to refresh.

subject_type.description: Which subject the stored OAuth token should belong to.

spotify_user_id.description: Spotify user id to select tokens for when subject_type is spotify_user.

force_refresh.description: If true, refresh the access token even if it is not yet expired.

tool_schemas.name: search
tool_schemas.description: Searches the Spotify catalog for the given query across one or more item types and returns Spotify-style paging objects per type, using limit and offset to page results independently within each type. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when q is empty, type is missing/empty, limit or offset are out of range, or market/include_external are invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when no valid server access token is available and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the audit-log quota/rate limit prevents performing the upstream search call.

q.description: The search query (keywords and/or Spotify search operators).

market.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter availability.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return per type.

offset.description: The index of the first result to return (pagination offset).

include_external.description: If set to audio, include externally hosted audio in results when supported.

tool_schemas.name: get_artist
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single artist from the Spotify catalog by artist_id and returns the artist object (using the local mirror when available, otherwise fetching and caching from Spotify). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if artist_id is missing/empty, NOT_FOUND if the artist does not exist on Spotify, and UNAUTHORIZED if no valid access token is available. Raises TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the audit-log quota/rate limit prevents fetching the artist from Spotify.

tool_schemas.name: get_multiple_artists
tool_schemas.description: Fetches up to 50 artists by ID and returns an array of artist objects in the same order as requested (mirrored locally when available, otherwise fetched and cached). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if artist_ids is empty, contains more than 50 IDs, or contains invalid/blank IDs. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid access token is available and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the audit-log quota/rate limit prevents completing the upstream fetch.

artist_ids.description: List of Spotify artist ids (up to 50).

tool_schemas.name: get_artist_top_tracks
tool_schemas.description: Returns the artist’s top tracks for the specified market as an array of track objects, applying Spotify relinking/availability rules for that country. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if artist_id is missing/empty or market is not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, and NOT_FOUND if the artist does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid access token is available and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the audit-log quota/rate limit blocks the upstream request.

market.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to select top tracks for a specific market.

tool_schemas.name: get_artist_related_artists
tool_schemas.description: Returns a list of artists Spotify considers related to the given artist, as an array of artist objects. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if artist_id is missing/empty and NOT_FOUND if the artist does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid access token is available and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the audit-log quota/rate limit blocks the upstream request.

tool_schemas.name: get_artist_albums
tool_schemas.description: Lists an artist’s albums as a Spotify paging object (items plus limit/offset-based pagination), optionally filtered by include_groups and market for availability. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if artist_id is missing/empty, include_groups contains invalid values, or limit/offset/market are out of range/invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the artist does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED if no valid access token is available, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the audit-log quota/rate limit blocks the upstream request.

include_groups.description: Filter results by the types of releases.

market.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter album availability.

limit.description: Maximum number of albums to return.

offset.description: The index of the first album to return (pagination offset).

tool_schemas.name: get_album
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single album from the Spotify catalog by album_id and returns the album object, applying optional market-based relinking/availability for its tracks. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if album_id is missing/empty or market is invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the album does not exist on Spotify. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid access token is available and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the audit-log quota/rate limit prevents fetching the album.

market.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter track relinking/availability.

tool_schemas.name: get_album_tracks
tool_schemas.description: Lists the tracks for an album as a Spotify paging object using limit and offset for pagination, applying optional market-based relinking/availability. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if album_spotify_id is missing/empty, limit/offset are out of range, or market is invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the album does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED if no valid access token is available, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the audit-log quota/rate limit blocks the upstream request.

album_spotify_id.description: The Spotify ID of the album whose tracks to fetch.

market.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter track relinking/availability.

limit.description: Maximum number of tracks to return (Spotify paging limit).

offset.description: The index of the first track to return (Spotify paging offset).

tool_schemas.name: get_multiple_albums
tool_schemas.description: Fetches up to 20 albums by ID and returns an array of album objects in the same order as requested, applying optional market-based availability. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if album_spotify_ids is empty, contains more than 20 IDs, or includes invalid/blank IDs, or if market is invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid access token is available and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the audit-log quota/rate limit prevents completing the upstream fetch.

album_spotify_ids.description: List of Spotify album IDs to fetch (max 20 per request).

market.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter album availability.

tool_schemas.name: get_track
tool_schemas.description: Fetches Spotify catalog metadata for the given track_spotify_id and returns the Track object, applying relinking/availability for the provided market when present. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if track_spotify_id is missing/empty or market is not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, UNAUTHORIZED if no valid Spotify OAuth tokens are available, NOT_FOUND if the track ID does not exist, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the server’s audited Spotify-call quota/rate limits would be exceeded.

track_spotify_id.description: The Spotify ID of the track to fetch.

market.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter track relinking/availability.

tool_schemas.name: get_available_genres
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current list of available seed genres that Spotify supports for recommendations as an array of strings (no paging). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid Spotify OAuth tokens are available and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the server’s audited Spotify-call quota/rate limits would be exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get_new_releases
tool_schemas.description: Lists featured new-release albums for the optional country and returns Spotify’s paged Albums result; use limit (1–50) and offset (0+) to page through results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if country is not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or limit/offset are out of range, UNAUTHORIZED if no valid Spotify OAuth tokens are available, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the server’s audited Spotify-call quota/rate limits would be exceeded.

country.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to get new releases for a specific country.

limit.description: Maximum number of new release albums to return (Spotify paging limit).

offset.description: The index of the first new release album to return (Spotify paging offset).

tool_schemas.name: get_recommendations
tool_schemas.description: Generates track recommendations from the provided seed_tracks_spotify_ids, seed_artists_spotify_ids, and/or seed_genres and returns Spotify’s Recommendations payload containing up to limit tracks (no offset-based paging). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if no seeds are provided, if more than 5 total seed values are supplied across all seed lists, if limit is out of range (1–100), or if market is not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid Spotify OAuth tokens are available and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the server’s audited Spotify-call quota/rate limits would be exceeded.

seed_tracks_spotify_ids.description: Seed track Spotify IDs used to generate recommendations.

seed_artists_spotify_ids.description: Seed artist Spotify IDs used to generate recommendations.

seed_genres.description: Seed genre strings used to generate recommendations.

market.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter track availability.

limit.description: Maximum number of recommended tracks to return.

tunable_attributes.description: Recommendation tunings (e.g., min/max/target_*) passed through to Spotify.

tool_schemas.name: get_audiobook
tool_schemas.description: Fetches Spotify catalog metadata for the given audiobook_spotify_id and returns the Audiobook object, filtered for availability in the provided market when present. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if audiobook_spotify_id is missing/empty or market is not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, UNAUTHORIZED if no valid Spotify OAuth tokens are available, NOT_FOUND if the audiobook ID does not exist, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the server’s audited Spotify-call quota/rate limits would be exceeded.

audiobook_spotify_id.description: The Spotify ID of the audiobook to fetch.

market.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter audiobook availability.

tool_schemas.name: get_multiple_audiobooks
tool_schemas.description: Fetches Spotify catalog metadata for the given list of audiobook_spotify_ids (1–50) and returns an array of Audiobook objects, filtered for availability in the provided market when present. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the ID list is empty, exceeds 50, or market is not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid Spotify OAuth tokens are available and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the server’s audited Spotify-call quota/rate limits would be exceeded.

audiobook_spotify_ids.description: List of Spotify audiobook IDs to fetch (max 50 per request).

market.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter audiobook availability.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_multiple_audiobooks(audiobook_spotify_ids, market=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re, uuid

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0062000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0062000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)

    def _parse_dt(v):
        if v is None:
            return None
        if isinstance(v, datetime.datetime):
            return v if v.tzinfo else v.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        if isinstance(v, str):
            s = v.strip()
            if s.endswith("Z"):
                s = s[:-1] + "+00:00"
            try:
                dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
                return dt if dt.tzinfo else dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
            except Exception:
                return None
        return None

    def _iso(dt):
        if not isinstance(dt, datetime.datetime):
            return None
        if dt.tzinfo is None:
            dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        return dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    def _new_id(prefix):
        return f"{prefix}_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"

    def _log_request(api_requests, tool_name, oauth_token_id, request_params, status, *,
                     spotify_endpoint=None, http_method=None, response_status_code=None,
                     response_time_ms=None, result_cache_hit=False, error_message=None):
        now = _now()
        row = {
            "id": _new_id("req"),
            "tool_name": tool_name,
            "oauth_token_id": oauth_token_id,
            "spotify_endpoint": spotify_endpoint,
            "http_method": http_method,
            "request_params": request_params,
            "response_status_code": response_status_code,
            "response_time_ms": response_time_ms,
            "result_cache_hit": bool(result_cache_hit),
            "status": status,
            "error_message": error_message,
            "created_at": _iso(now),
            "updated_at": _iso(now),
        }
        api_requests.append(row)
        return row

    # --- Validate inputs first ---
    if not isinstance(audiobook_spotify_ids, list):
        # Still log call (no token context, validation failure)
        api_requests = _load("api_requests.json")
        _log_request(
            api_requests,
            "get_multiple_audiobooks",
            None,
            {"audiobook_spotify_ids": audiobook_spotify_ids, "market": market},
            "failed",
            result_cache_hit=False,
            error_message="audiobook_spotify_ids must be an array of strings",
        )
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "audiobook_spotify_ids must be an array of strings")

    if len(audiobook_spotify_ids) < 1:
        api_requests = _load("api_requests.json")
        _log_request(
            api_requests,
            "get_multiple_audiobooks",
            None,
            {"audiobook_spotify_ids": audiobook_spotify_ids, "market": market},
            "failed",
            result_cache_hit=False,
            error_message="audiobook_spotify_ids must contain at least 1 id",
        )
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "audiobook_spotify_ids must contain at least 1 id")

    if len(audiobook_spotify_ids) > 50:
        api_requests = _load("api_requests.json")
        _log_request(
            api_requests,
            "get_multiple_audiobooks",
            None,
            {"audiobook_spotify_ids": audiobook_spotify_ids, "market": market},
            "failed",
            result_cache_hit=False,
            error_message="audiobook_spotify_ids must not exceed 50 ids",
        )
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "audiobook_spotify_ids must not exceed 50 ids")

    for i, sid in enumerate(audiobook_spotify_ids):
        if not isinstance(sid, str) or not sid.strip():
            api_requests = _load("api_requests.json")
            _log_request(
                api_requests,
                "get_multiple_audiobooks",
                None,
                {"audiobook_spotify_ids": audiobook_spotify_ids, "market": market},
                "failed",
                result_cache_hit=False,
                error_message=f"audiobook_spotify_ids[{i}] must be a non-empty string",
            )
            _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"audiobook_spotify_ids[{i}] must be a non-empty string")

    if market is not None:
        if not isinstance(market, str):
            api_requests = _load("api_requests.json")
            _log_request(
                api_requests,
                "get_multiple_audiobooks",
                None,
                {"audiobook_spotify_ids": audiobook_spotify_ids, "market": market},
                "failed",
                result_cache_hit=False,
                error_message="market must be a string ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code",
            )
            _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "market must be a string ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code")
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z]{2}", market.strip()):
            api_requests = _load("api_requests.json")
            _log_request(
                api_requests,
                "get_multiple_audiobooks",
                None,
                {"audiobook_spotify_ids": audiobook_spotify_ids, "market": market},
                "failed",
                result_cache_hit=False,
                error_message="market must be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code",
            )
            _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "market must be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code")
        market = market.strip().upper()

    # --- Load store ---
    oauth_tokens = _load("oauth_tokens.json")
    catalog_items = _load("catalog_items.json")
    api_requests = _load("api_requests.json")

    # --- Choose a valid active server token and update any expired ones as per rules ---
    now = _now()
    changed_tokens = False
    for t in oauth_tokens:
        if t.get("subject_type") == "server" and t.get("status") == "active":
            exp = _parse_dt(t.get("expires_at"))
            if exp is not None and exp <= now:
                # active -> expired transition is allowed
                t["status"] = "expired"
                t["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
                changed_tokens = True

    # Find an active server token suitable for public catalog endpoints
    active_server_tokens = []
    for t in oauth_tokens:
        if t.get("subject_type") != "server":
            continue
        if t.get("status") != "active":
            continue
        exp = _parse_dt(t.get("expires_at"))
        if exp is None or exp <= now:
            continue
        if t.get("token_type") != "Bearer":
            continue
        active_server_tokens.append(t)

    if not active_server_tokens:
        # Log every call
        _log_request(
            api_requests,
            "get_multiple_audiobooks",
            None,
            {"audiobook_spotify_ids": audiobook_spotify_ids, "market": market},
            "failed",
            spotify_endpoint=None,
            http_method=None,
            response_status_code=None,
            response_time_ms=None,
            result_cache_hit=False,
            error_message="No active server OAuth token available",
        )
        if changed_tokens:
            _save("oauth_tokens.json", oauth_tokens)
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active Spotify OAuth token available for server subject")

    # Pick the token that expires latest (most stable)
    active_server_tokens.sort(key=lambda r: (_parse_dt(r.get("expires_at")) or now), reverse=True)
    token = active_server_tokens[0]
    token_id = token.get("id")

    # --- Cache check for each audiobook ---
    # Cache rule: serve from cache when cache_status='fresh' and expires_at > now
    by_key = {}
    for ci in catalog_items:
        if ci.get("entity_type") == "audiobook" and isinstance(ci.get("spotify_id"), str):
            by_key[ci["spotify_id"]] = ci

    cache_hits = []
    cache_misses = []
    for sid in audiobook_spotify_ids:
        row = by_key.get(sid)
        if not row:
            cache_misses.append(sid)
            continue
        if row.get("cache_status") != "fresh":
            cache_misses.append(sid)
            continue
        exp = _parse_dt(row.get("expires_at"))
        if exp is None or exp <= now:
            cache_misses.append(sid)
            continue
        cache_hits.append(row)

    # If all found in cache, return from cache (no outbound call)
    if len(cache_misses) == 0:
        # Update token last_used_at
        token["last_used_at"] = _iso(now)
        token["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
        changed_tokens = True

        # Update cached items updated_at/last accessed? (schema doesn't have last_accessed; only cached_at/expires_at)
        # Keep as-is, but touch updated_at to reflect use? Not required by rules; avoid unnecessary writes.

        # Log
        _log_request(
            api_requests,
            "get_multiple_audiobooks",
            token_id,
            {"audiobook_spotify_ids": audiobook_spotify_ids, "market": market},
            "succeeded",
            spotify_endpoint=None,
            http_method=None,
            response_status_code=None,
            response_time_ms=0,
            result_cache_hit=True,
            error_message=None,
        )

        if changed_tokens:
            _save("oauth_tokens.json", oauth_tokens)
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)

        # Return ordered list corresponding to request ids; omit items not found? Spotify returns array for found ids.
        # From cache, only items present; filter by requested ordering.
        raw_by_id = {r.get("spotify_id"): r.get("raw_json") for r in cache_hits}
        items = []
        for sid in audiobook_spotify_ids:
            rj = raw_by_id.get(sid)
            if rj is not None:
                items.append(rj)
        return {
            "audiobooks": items,
            "market": market,
            "cache": {"hit": True, "hit_count": len(items), "miss_count": 0},
        }

    # --- Outbound call required; offline datastore cannot reach Spotify ---
    # Real behavior: would call GET /v1/audiobooks?ids=...&market=...
    # Here: fail with NOT_FOUND for missing cache? The business rules indicate refusal only on missing token;
    # but without Spotify connectivity we must surface a failure. Record failed request with endpoint/method.
    start = time.time()
    elapsed_ms = int((time.time() - start) * 1000)

    # Update token last_used_at even on failure (attempted use)
    token["last_used_at"] = _iso(now)
    token["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
    changed_tokens = True

    endpoint = "/v1/audiobooks"
    params = {"ids": ",".join(audiobook_spotify_ids)}
    if market is not None:
        params["market"] = market

    _log_request(
        api_requests,
        "get_multiple_audiobooks",
        token_id,
        {"audiobook_spotify_ids": audiobook_spotify_ids, "market": market},
        "failed",
        spotify_endpoint=endpoint,
        http_method="GET",
        response_status_code=None,
        response_time_ms=elapsed_ms,
        result_cache_hit=False,
        error_message="Spotify fetch required but no cached data available in local datastore",
    )

    if changed_tokens:
        _save("oauth_tokens.json", oauth_tokens)
    _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)

    return _err(
        "NOT_FOUND",
        "Requested audiobooks not available in cache and cannot be fetched in offline mode",
        cache={"hit_count": len(cache_hits), "miss_ids": cache_misses},
    )

tool_schemas.name: get_audiobook_chapters
tool_schemas.description: Lists chapters for the given audiobook_spotify_id and returns Spotify’s paged Chapters result; use limit (1–50) and offset (0+) to page through chapters, with availability filtered by market when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if audiobook_spotify_id is missing/empty, market is not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or limit/offset are out of range; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid Spotify OAuth tokens are available, NOT_FOUND if the audiobook ID does not exist, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the server’s audited Spotify-call quota/rate limits would be exceeded.

audiobook_spotify_id.description: Spotify ID of the audiobook to fetch chapters for.

market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter content availability.

limit.description: Maximum number of chapters to return.

offset.description: Index of the first chapter to return (pagination offset).

tool_schemas.name: get_playlist
tool_schemas.description: Fetches Spotify catalog metadata for the given playlist_spotify_id and returns the Playlist object, honoring fields and additional_types when provided and applying relinking/availability for market when present. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if playlist_spotify_id is missing/empty, market is not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or additional_types contains values other than track/episode; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid Spotify OAuth tokens are available, NOT_FOUND if the playlist ID does not exist, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the server’s audited Spotify-call quota/rate limits would be exceeded.

playlist_spotify_id.description: Spotify ID of the playlist to fetch.

market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter track relinking and availability.

fields.description: Spotify 'fields' selector to limit which playlist fields are returned.

additional_types.description: Additional item types to return in the playlist (Spotify additional_types).

tool_schemas.name: get_playlist_tracks
tool_schemas.description: Lists the tracks in the given playlist_spotify_id and returns Spotify’s paged PlaylistTracks result; use limit (1–100) and offset (0+) to page through items, honoring fields and additional_types and applying relinking/availability for market when present. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if playlist_spotify_id is missing/empty, market is not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, limit/offset are out of range, or additional_types contains values other than track/episode; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid Spotify OAuth tokens are available, NOT_FOUND if the playlist ID does not exist, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the server’s audited Spotify-call quota/rate limits would be exceeded.

playlist_spotify_id.description: Spotify ID of the playlist to fetch tracks for.

market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter track relinking and availability.

fields.description: Spotify 'fields' selector to limit which playlist track fields are returned.

limit.description: Maximum number of playlist tracks to return.

offset.description: Index of the first playlist track to return (pagination offset).

additional_types.description: Additional item types to return in the playlist (Spotify additional_types).

tool_schemas.name: get_playlist_items
tool_schemas.description: Lists the items in the given playlist_spotify_id and returns Spotify’s paged PlaylistItems result; use limit (1–100) and offset (0+) to page through items, honoring fields and additional_types and applying relinking/availability for market when present. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if playlist_spotify_id is missing/empty, market is not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, limit/offset are out of range, or additional_types contains values other than track/episode; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid Spotify OAuth tokens are available, NOT_FOUND if the playlist ID does not exist, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the server’s audited Spotify-call quota/rate limits would be exceeded.

playlist_spotify_id.description: Spotify ID of the playlist to fetch items for.

market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter item relinking and availability.

fields.description: Spotify 'fields' selector to limit which playlist item fields are returned.

limit.description: Maximum number of playlist items to return.

offset.description: Index of the first playlist item to return (pagination offset).

additional_types.description: Additional item types to return in the playlist (Spotify additional_types).

tool_schemas.name: modify_playlist
tool_schemas.description: Updates the specified playlist’s details (name, public/private visibility, collaborative flag, and/or description) and returns the updated playlist metadata/snapshot as provided by Spotify. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if playlist_spotify_id is missing/empty or if any provided fields are of the wrong type; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no stored Spotify OAuth session is available, FORBIDDEN if the current user is not allowed to edit that playlist, and NOT_FOUND if the playlist_spotify_id does not exist or is not accessible to the user. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the server’s audit-log quota for Spotify calls is exceeded, and CONFLICT if Spotify rejects the requested state change (for example, an invalid collaborative/visibility transition) or the playlist is otherwise not modifiable at the time of the request.

playlist_spotify_id.description: Spotify ID of the playlist to modify.

public.description: Whether the playlist should be public (true) or private (false).

collaborative.description: Whether the playlist should be collaborative.

tool_schemas.name: add_tracks_to_playlist
tool_schemas.description: Adds the given list of Spotify track URIs to the target playlist, inserting at the zero-based position if provided (otherwise appending), and returns the new playlist snapshot information from Spotify. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if playlist_spotify_id is missing/empty, uris is empty, any URI is not a string/track URI, or position is negative; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no stored Spotify OAuth session is available, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot edit the playlist, and NOT_FOUND if the playlist does not exist or any referenced track is unavailable in the current context. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the server-side call quota is exceeded and CONFLICT when Spotify refuses the modification due to playlist state or write restrictions.

playlist_spotify_id.description: Spotify ID of the playlist to add tracks to.

uris.description: List of Spotify track URIs to add (e.g., 'spotify:track:...').

position.description: Zero-based position to insert the items at (defaults to append).

tool_schemas.name: remove_tracks_from_playlist
tool_schemas.description: Removes one or more track occurrences from the specified playlist, optionally constrained to the provided zero-based positions for each track, and returns the resulting playlist snapshot information from Spotify. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if playlist_spotify_id is missing/empty, tracks is empty, any track entry lacks a uri, any position is negative, or snapshot_id is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no stored Spotify OAuth session is available and FORBIDDEN if the user cannot edit the playlist. Raises NOT_FOUND if the playlist does not exist/is inaccessible, CONFLICT if snapshot_id is provided and does not match the playlist’s current snapshot (optimistic concurrency failure) or Spotify refuses the change due to playlist state, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the server’s Spotify-call quota is exceeded.

playlist_spotify_id.description: Spotify ID of the playlist to remove tracks from.

positions.description: Specific zero-based positions of the track to remove; omit to remove all occurrences.

tracks.description: Tracks to remove, optionally constrained to specific positions.

snapshot_id.description: Playlist snapshot ID to enforce optimistic concurrency control.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_user_playlists
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current user’s playlists (owned or followed) as a paged list, using limit (max 50) and offset as Spotify-style pagination and including the page metadata returned by Spotify. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit/offset are out of range or not integers, and UNAUTHORIZED if there is no stored Spotify OAuth session for the current user. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the server’s audit-log quota for Spotify calls is exceeded and FORBIDDEN if the user’s token lacks permission to read the user’s library/playlists.

limit.description: Maximum number of playlists to return.

offset.description: Index of the first playlist to return (pagination offset).

tool_schemas.name: get_featured_playlists
tool_schemas.description: Returns Spotify’s featured playlists as a paged list for the given market/locale/timestamp (if supplied), using limit (max 50) and offset pagination and returning Spotify’s page metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if market/locale/timestamp are malformed or if limit/offset are out of range, and UNAUTHORIZED if no stored Spotify OAuth session is available. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the server’s Spotify-call quota is exceeded and NOT_FOUND when Spotify has no featured-playlist feed for the requested market/context.

market.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to tailor results to a particular market.

locale.description: The desired language/region for the returned content (e.g., "en_US").

timestamp.description: An ISO 8601 timestamp to get featured playlists active at a specific time.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return.

offset.description: The index of the first item to return (for pagination).

tool_schemas.name: get_category_playlists
tool_schemas.description: Returns playlists for the given Spotify category_id as a paged list, optionally tailored by market, using limit (max 50) and offset pagination and returning Spotify’s page metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if category_id is missing/empty, market is malformed, or limit/offset are out of range, and UNAUTHORIZED if no stored Spotify OAuth session is available. Raises NOT_FOUND if the category_id does not exist/is not available for the requested market, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the server’s audit-log quota for Spotify calls is exceeded.

category_id.description: The Spotify category ID to fetch playlists for (e.g., "party", "focus").

market.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to tailor results to a particular market.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return.

offset.description: The index of the first item to return (for pagination).

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity for this Spotify Server, including the subject type and Spotify user id (when applicable), the effective OAuth scopes, and the current quota/rate-limit consumption derived from the api_requests audit log. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid active token is available for the selected subject, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS if the server is currently throttling requests.

spotify_user_id.description: Spotify user id when subject_type is spotify_user.

tool_schemas.name: list_oauth_tokens
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored OAuth token records, optionally filtered by subject and status, ordered by most recently updated. Returns a paged list of oauth_tokens rows for troubleshooting and lifecycle visibility. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters or pagination.

spotify_user_id.description: Filter tokens by Spotify user id (only valid when subject_type is spotify_user).

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

offset.description: Number of rows to skip before returning results.

tool_schemas.name: update_oauth_token
tool_schemas.description: Updates a stored OAuth token row by id, including driving allowed lifecycle transitions on status (active↔expired, active/expired→revoked). Returns the updated oauth_tokens row. Refuses INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION when a requested status change is not allowed, and NOT_FOUND when the id does not exist.

id.description: Primary key of the oauth_tokens row to update.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the token (must be an allowed transition).

last_used_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp to record when the token was last used.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp indicating when the access token expires.

scope.description: Space-delimited OAuth scopes associated with the token.

tool_schemas.name: list_catalog_items
tool_schemas.description: Lists locally mirrored Spotify catalog objects from catalog_items, optionally filtered by entity_type, spotify_id, cache_status, and owner_spotify_user_id. Returns a paged list of catalog_items rows for cache inspection and troubleshooting. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters or pagination.

spotify_id.description: Filter by the Spotify id for the item.

owner_spotify_user_id.description: Filter by owner Spotify user id (primarily for playlists).

q_name.description: Case-insensitive substring match against name for quick local lookup.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

offset.description: Number of rows to skip before returning results.

tool_schemas.name: update_catalog_item
tool_schemas.description: Updates a catalog_items row by id, including driving allowed cache_status lifecycle transitions (fresh↔stale, fresh/stale→evicted, evicted→fresh). Returns the updated catalog_items row. Refuses INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION when a requested cache_status change is not allowed, and NOT_FOUND when the id does not exist.

id.description: Primary key of the catalog_items row to update.

cache_status.description: New cache lifecycle status (must be an allowed transition).

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp indicating when this cached object should be treated as expired.

raw_json.description: Raw Spotify payload to store for this item (overwrites existing raw_json).

description_text.description: Description text for the item when applicable (e.g., playlist).

tool_schemas.name: list_api_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists audit-log entries for tool invocations (api_requests), optionally filtered by tool_name, oauth_token_id, status, and time range. Returns a paged list of api_requests rows for quota enforcement visibility and troubleshooting. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters or pagination.

tool_name.description: Filter by the tool name that was invoked.

oauth_token_id.description: Filter by oauth token id used (when applicable).

result_cache_hit.description: Filter by whether the result was served from cache.

created_at_gte.description: RFC 3339 timestamp; include requests created at or after this time.

created_at_lte.description: RFC 3339 timestamp; include requests created at or before this time.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

offset.description: Number of rows to skip before returning results.

metadata.name: Spotify Server
metadata.description: This backend powers an MCP wrapper around the Spotify Web API. It stores the server's Spotify OAuth tokens, local mirrors of Spotify catalog objects (artists/albums/tracks/audiobooks/playlists), and an audit log of API calls to enforce quotas and support troubleshooting. Repository: https://github.c
